## Change

What does this fix or improve? Link the issue.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm audit --prod`, and `pnpm build` pass.
- [ ] Smoke tests pass against the built app.
- [ ] Affected UI works at desktop and phone widths; screenshots stay out of Git.
- [ ] No credentials, private registrations, generated builds, or browser state added.
- [ ] Asset rights/credits and free learning-resource links checked where relevant.

## Risks

Describe changed behavior, database setup (if any), and rollback needs.
